purpose: Define additive and breaking schema evolution, migration requirements and compatibility evidence without silently reinterpreting existing stored data or relation semantics.

topics.name: Schema Evolution
topics.purpose: Define additive and breaking schema evolution, migration requirements and compatibility evidence without silently reinterpreting existing stored data or relation semantics.

semantics.additive_rule: Compatible additive fields/relations may preserve schema identity/version compatibility according to policy.
semantics.breaking_rule: Breaking semantic change requires explicit incompatible version/new identity where owning versioning policy requires.
semantics.migration_rule: Stored/instance data migration is explicit and separate from schema definition change.
semantics.field_rule: Field rename, split, merge, type change or semantic repurpose is explicitly mapped.
semantics.relation_rule: Relation/cardinality/FK changes are explicit compatibility/migration events.
semantics.default_rule: Adding a default does not silently backfill historical data unless migration explicitly does so.
semantics.evidence_rule: Compatibility/migration decision retains semantic diff and provenance.

invariants.rule: Schema, field and relation identities are explicit and stable; instance data, presentation labels and physical storage never define canonical schema semantics.

hard_gates.condition: breaking field semantics published as compatible silently

references.purpose: Schema evolution uses semantic diff evidence.
